D’Esposito

bibl.title: The what, where and how of delay activity

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: DELAY ACTIVITY - NEURAL ACTIVITY THAT PERSISTS DURING THE RETENTION INTERVAL OF DELAY TASKS, reconsidered as to WHAT IT IS, WHERE IN THE BRAIN IT IS FOUND, WHAT ROLES IT SERVES AND HOW IT MAY BE GENERATED
span.quote: Working memory is characterized by neural activity that persists during the retention interval of delay tasks. Despite the ubiquity of this ‘delay activity’ across tasks, species and experimental techniques, our understanding of this phenomenon remains incomplete. Although initially there was a narrow focus on sustained activation in a small number of brain regions, methodological and analytical advances have allowed researchers to uncover previously unobserved forms of delay activity across the entire brain. In light of these new findings, this Review reconsiders what delay activity is, where in the brain it is found, what roles it serves and how it may be generated.

span.label: what the object even is, once the methods have changed - METHODOLOGICAL AND ANALYTICAL ADVANCES HAVE ALLOWED RESEARCHERS TO UNCOVER PREVIOUSLY UNOBSERVED FORMS OF DELAY ACTIVITY ACROSS THE ENTIRE BRAIN
span.quote: Although initially there was a narrow focus on sustained activation in a small number of brain regions, methodological and analytical advances have allowed researchers to uncover previously unobserved forms of delay activity across the entire brain.

span.label: an expanded definition - ANY TASK-RELATED CHANGE IN NEURAL ACTIVITY THAT SPANS THE INTERVAL BETWEEN A STIMULUS AND THE BEHAVIOURAL RESPONSE IN A WM DELAY TASK - and an account of what it costs
span.quote: discussions of delay activity that typically focus on increases in spike rate or functional MRI (fMRI) signal that persist throughout a WM delay, we consider delay activity to be any task-related change in neural activity that spans the interval between a stimulus and the behavioural response in a WM delay task . This expanded definition allows for a more inclusive and comprehensive evaluation of delay activity, but at the same time calls attention to the challenge of comparing data across different experimental methods, brain regions and species.

span.label: critique
span.quote: First, although delay activity has classically been described as sustained activation of highly tuned neurons or neural populations, the abundance of evidence for time-varying forms of delay activity and population coding indicates that a broader view of delay activity is necessary.

span.label: delay activity in working memory
span.quote: Working memory is characterized by neural activity that persists during the retention interval of delay tasks.

span.label: review
span.quote: This Review integrates findings across subfields of neuroscience to critically evaluate the what, where and how of delay activity.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Structured recurrent excitation with tuned excitation–inhibition balance lets network spiking settle into a self-sustaining attractor state that keeps the memory alive without input
span.quote: When the connectivity between neurons in the network is properly structured, and when the balance between excitation and inhibition is well-tuned, spiking dynamics settle into a stable attractor state in the absence of any input

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Slow NMDA-receptor excitation stabilises attractor networks so that persistent spiking can be maintained over seconds
span.quote: The relatively slow excitatory dynamics of NMDAR activation can provide a stabilizing influence on attractor networks, allowing these networks to sustain a representation through persistent spiking over several seconds

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Encoding-driven changes in synaptic weights turn the network into a matched filter, so the memory is stored silently and revealed when noisy input is fed through it
span.quote: shifts in synaptic weights during stimulus encoding cause the network to act as a matched filter

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Feedforward connections between similarly tuned cells relay brief bursts of spiking along a chain, storing information without any single cell firing continuously
span.quote: This connectivity enables the network to store information through brief periods of above-baseline spiking that are passed between cells

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Long-range input (from thalamus) is required for local cortical circuits to sustain delay activity at all
span.quote: local circuit mechanisms, which have long been implicated in delay activity, may be insufficient to sustain delay activity in the absence of long-range input

span.label: the definition is widened deliberately and its price is named in the same sentence: THIS EXPANDED DEFINITION ALLOWS FOR A MORE INCLUSIVE AND COMPREHENSIVE EVALUATION OF DELAY ACTIVITY, BUT AT THE SAME TIME CALLS ATTENTION TO THE CHALLENGE OF COMPARING DATA ACROSS DIFFERENT EXPERIMENTAL METHODS, BRAIN REGIONS AND SPECIES
span.quote: discussions of delay activity that typically focus on increases in spike rate or functional MRI (fMRI) signal that persist throughout a WM delay, we consider delay activity to be any task-related change in neural activity that spans the interval between a stimulus and the behavioural response in a WM delay task . This expanded definition allows for a more inclusive and comprehensive evaluation of delay activity, but at the same time calls attention to the challenge of comparing data across different experimental methods, brain regions and species.

span.label: and the one design that escapes the problem: WE ADDRESS THIS ISSUE BY HIGHLIGHTING STUDIES THAT RECORD DELAY ACTIVITY ACROSS MULTIPLE BRAIN REGIONS IN THE SAME EXPERIMENT
span.quote: We address this issue by highlighting studies that record delay activity across multiple brain regions in the same experiment. Second, we emphasize points of connection between empirical studies and neural models of delay activity.

span.label: a code that cannot be read from its parts: THE PROPERTY OF NONLINEAR MIXED SELECTIVITY ENABLES INDIVIDUAL NEURONS TO RESPOND TO COMBINATIONS OF TASK AND STIMULUS FEATURES SUCH THAT FEATURE COMBINATIONS CANNOT BE READ OUT FROM THE RESPONSES OF THE INDIVIDUAL NEURON ALONE AND INSTEAD ARE ENCODED IN THE COMBINED ACTIVITY OF SEVERAL NEURONS
span.quote: The property of nonlinear mixed selectivity enables individual neurons to respond to combinations of task and stimulus features such that feature combinations cannot be read out from the responses of the individual neuron alone 124 and instead are encoded in the combined activity of several neurons

span.label: DELAY ACTIVITY IS SEEN MORE GENERALLY IN CONTEXTS THAT REQUIRE AN ORGANISM TO LINK A SENSORY STIMULUS TO A DELAYED BEHAVIOUR, SUCH AS DURING TASKS OF SUSTAINED ATTENTION OR DECISION MAKING; HERE, HOWEVER, WE EXAMINE DELAY ACTIVITY IN TASKS EXPLICITLY TESTING WM, WHERE IT HAS BEEN CHARACTERIZED MOST EXTENSIVELY
span.quote: Delay activity is seen more generally in contexts that require an organism to link a sensory stimulus to a delayed behaviour, such as during tasks of sustained attention 6 or decision making 7 ; here, however, we examine delay activity in tasks explicitly testing WM, where it has been characterized most extensively.

span.label: The broad definition the review adopts makes comparison across methods, regions and species harder.
span.quote: This expanded definition allows for a more inclusive and comprehensive evaluation of delay activity, but at the same time calls attention to the challenge of comparing data across different experimental methods, brain regions and species.

span.label: AS THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE BIOPHYSICAL PROPERTIES OF NEURONS OR MICRO-SCALE NETWORKS AND THE EFP OR BOLD SIGNALS IS INCOMPLETELY UNDERSTOOD, BIOPHYSICAL MODELS ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY ATTEMPT TO DESCRIBE SPIKING ACTIVITY; ACCORDINGLY, WE FOCUS OUR DISCUSSION HERE ON DELAY SPIKING
span.quote: As the relationship between the biophysical properties of neurons or micro-scale networks and the EFP or BOLD signals is incompletely understood, biophysical models almost exclusively attempt to describe spiking activity; accordingly, we focus our discussion here on delay spiking.

span.label: the expanded definition makes the literature harder to compare, not easier - THE CHALLENGE OF COMPARING DATA ACROSS DIFFERENT EXPERIMENTAL METHODS, BRAIN REGIONS AND SPECIES
span.quote: discussions of delay activity that typically focus on increases in spike rate or functional MRI (fMRI) signal that persist throughout a WM delay, we consider delay activity to be any task-related change in neural activity that spans the interval between a stimulus and the behavioural response in a WM delay task . This expanded definition allows for a more inclusive and comprehensive evaluation of delay activity, but at the same time calls attention to the challenge of comparing data across different experimental methods, brain regions and species.

span.label: DIFFERENCES IN TASKS, METHODOLOGY AND SPECIES IN THE ABOVE STUDIES POSE A SIGNIFICANT OBSTACLE TO UNCOVERING THE LOCATION AND FUNCTION OF DELAY ACTIVITY
span.quote: Differences in tasks, methodology and species in the above studies pose a significant obstacle to uncovering the location and function of delay activity. Here we consider studies that directly compare delay activity across regions.

span.label: each instrument sees a different thing - RECORDING DELAY ACTIVITY AT THESE DIFFERENT SCALES REQUIRES MULTIPLE TECHNIQUES, EACH OF WHICH IS SENSITIVE TO DIFFERENT ASPECTS OF THE UNDERLYING NEURONAL SIGNALS
span.quote: Delay activity can be observed in many forms at various scales — from individual neurons, to cell assemblies comprised of tens of neurons, meso-scale interregional circuits or macro-level networks that recruit regions throughout the brain. Recording delay activity at these different scales requires multiple techniques, each of which is sensitive to different aspects of the underlying neuronal signals

span.label: and for one of those instruments the source is unknown - CHALLENGES IN LOCALIZING EEG ACTIVITY MAKE IT UNCLEAR WHERE IN THE BRAIN THESE SIGNALS ORIGINATE
span.quote: hallenges in localizing EEG activity make it unclear where in the brain these signals originate.
